# Sumud

> Sumud tells the story of Palestine and its people, before 1947 and after: its history, culture, and steadfastness (sumud). It is an independent, non-commercial project drawing on mainstream historical scholarship, United Nations records, and human rights reporting.

## History

- [History overview](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/history/): A seven-chapter narrative from Ottoman Palestine to the present.
- [Ottoman Palestine](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/history/ottoman-palestine/): Palestine as an Ottoman province, until 1917.
- [The British Mandate](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/history/british-mandate/): 1917-1947, the Balfour Declaration and growing conflict.
- [Partition and the Nakba](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/history/nakba/): 1947-1949, partition, war, and mass displacement.
- [Exile and Military Rule](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/history/occupation-and-exile/): 1949-1967, refugee life and the founding of the PLO.
- [Occupation and the Intifada](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/history/occupation-and-settlement/): 1967-1993, occupation, settlement, and uprising.
- [Oslo, and its Unravelling](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/history/oslo-to-blockade/): 1993-2007, the Oslo Accords through the Gaza blockade.
- [Siege, War and the Present](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/history/gaza-and-the-present/): 2007 to today.

## Culture and further reading

- [Culture & Sumud](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/culture/): Land, food, craft, language and literature, and the idea of sumud itself.
- [Further Reading](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/further-reading/): Recommended history, memoir, fiction and poetry about Palestine.
- [Glossary](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/glossary/): Terms, places and institutions used throughout the site, defined in one place.
- [Sources](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/sources/): The books, archives and organisations this project draws on.
- [Take Action](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/take-action/): Humanitarian and human rights organisations working on the ground.
- [About](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/about/): What this project is, and how to flag a correction.
- [Search](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/search/): Full-text search across the site.

## Feeds

- [RSS](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/rss.xml)

## Arabic (العربية)

Every page above has a full Arabic translation at the same path under `/ar/`, e.g.
https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/history/nakba/ for the Nakba chapter.

- [نظرة عامة على التاريخ](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/history/): سرد من سبعة فصول من فلسطين العثمانية إلى الحاضر.
- [فلسطين العثمانية](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/history/ottoman-palestine/): فلسطين كولاية عثمانية، حتى عام 1917.
- [الانتداب البريطاني](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/history/british-mandate/): 1917-1947، وعد بلفور والصراع المتنامي.
- [التقسيم والنكبة](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/history/nakba/): 1947-1949، التقسيم والحرب والتهجير الجماعي.
- [المنفى والحكم العسكري](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/history/occupation-and-exile/): 1949-1967، حياة اللاجئين وتأسيس منظمة التحرير الفلسطينية.
- [الاحتلال والانتفاضة](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/history/occupation-and-settlement/): 1967-1993، الاحتلال والاستيطان والانتفاضة.
- [أوسلو وانهياره](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/history/oslo-to-blockade/): 1993-2007، من اتفاقيات أوسلو إلى حصار غزة.
- [الحصار والحرب والحاضر](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/history/gaza-and-the-present/): من 2007 إلى اليوم.
- [الثقافة والصمود](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/culture/): الأرض والطعام والحرف واللغة والأدب، وفكرة الصمود نفسها.
- [قراءات إضافية](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/further-reading/): كتب تاريخ ومذكرات وأدب روائي وشعر موصى بها عن فلسطين.
- [المصطلحات](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/glossary/): مصطلحات وأماكن ومؤسسات مستخدمة في أنحاء الموقع.
- [المصادر](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/sources/): الكتب والأرشيفات والمنظمات التي يعتمد عليها هذا المشروع.
- [بادر بالفعل](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/take-action/): منظمات إنسانية وحقوقية تعمل ميدانيًا.
- [عن الموقع](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/about/): ماهية هذا المشروع، وكيفية الإبلاغ عن تصويب.
- [بحث](https://sumud.timothybrits.co.za/ar/search/): بحث نصي كامل في الموقع.
